business.name: RD Amazing
business.about_short: A print house in Dammam for every kind of paper and plastic print, and maker of printed paper cups, with luxury finishes worthy of your brand.

topbar: Printing and luxury packaging in Dammam

title: Complete printing,
finished in luxury
hero.lead: From business cards to incense and sweet boxes and printed cups: we design, print and pack under one roof, with chosen materials and finishes worthy of your name.
hero.note: We go over the design, size and quantity with you, and print only once you approve.

about.text: A print house in Dammam for paper and plastic print and printed paper cups, from the smallest card to the finest box. We care about what makes the difference: the material, the finish, true colour and delivery on time.

points.title: Design and print under one roof
points.text: We prepare the design or adjust your file, then print and pack in one place.

points.title: Luxury finishes
points.text: Gold and silver foil, embossing and debossing, matt and gloss lamination, and die-cutting.

points.title: A clear price and a date we keep
points.text: We agree the price and delivery date before we start, and we keep to them.

steps.title: Send your request
steps.text: Tell us the product, quantity and size, and send the design file if you have one.

steps.title: We review and confirm
steps.text: We agree the material, finish and price, and you see a proof before anything is printed.

steps.title: We print and deliver
steps.text: Printing starts once you approve, and you receive it on the agreed date.
